caption: The drawing depicts a semicircular carved relief featuring a central sheaf of wheat tied together, flanked on both sides by large leafy branches with smaller leaves extending outward. The relief has a raised border, decorated with a repeating pattern of diagonal lines. The colors used in the drawing are mostly in the beige and brown spectrum, giving the objects a stone or wood-like appearance. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects present. Near the bottom right of the drawing, the text "FRANKLIN SYAES" is printed in red.
title: Pa. German Butter Mold
